_how_to_use: 1. This file currently holds the site's EXISTING values - applying it is a safe no-op.
2. Edit only the values you want to change. Delete the rest if you like.
5. Add '--literals' to also rewrite raw hardcoded hex colours site-wide.
6. Commit to git BEFORE applying. A .bak file is written automatically.
_note: Only 'tokens' are applied by default. 'literals' is opt-in because it rewrites raw hex everywhere - always preview with --dry and check visually.
